policy: After once-only development selection, any distribution finalist additionally needs an exactly response-mean and blend-matched shuffled-target control, winning >=2 of fidelity/reach/overlap. No retuning or reselecting from its outcome. Compact finalists skip this distribution check. This supplements the conservative but not always exactly matched original shuffled25 check.
timing: Written before any generated-count or null outcomes. Response screening is still in progress; no numerical screen scores have been inspected for model selection.
